behavioral_effects: Stored and displayed MCP connection URLs are origin-only (scheme+host+port); paths, which can carry Zapier-style path tokens, no longer appear in the url column, API responses, error messages, repr output, or logs.

Migration 0030 re-stripped all 11 dev rows to origin-only display URLs (verified 11/11 matching ^https?://[^/]+$) and cleared stale last_error (0 remaining), with encrypted connect_url intact (11/11).

Regression tests, all failing before the fix and passing after: test_path_token_is_stripped, test_query_string_is_stripped, test_userinfo_is_stripped, test_fragment_is_stripped, test_port_survives, test_ipv6_host_keeps_brackets (test_ssrf.py); test_create_strips_a_path_embedded_token, test_create_splits_url_credentials, test_update_url_reencrypts_connect_url, test_query_string_is_scrubbed_from_error_messages, test_oauth_callback_exchanges_and_clears_state (test_mcp_connections.py).
compatibility_impact: The url field returned by /api/v1/me/mcp-connections now carries only the origin of the server URL (path dropped); the UI renders it as informational text, and no code path uses the display url to connect. Migration 0030 is data-only (no DDL) and its downgrade is a no-op since prior display forms remain derivable from connect_url. The OAuth moved detection now triggers on origin changes rather than path changes, matching its documented purpose of binding tokens to hosts.
limitations: The registered migrations validator (pytest tests/test_migrations.py) skips without a host-reachable database; migration 0030 was instead executed for real inside the fullstack-app-1 container against the dev Postgres and verified by row counts. The full upgrade/downgrade cycle from base was not exercised.

Both gaps came out of the security-review pass on 0aa294f, where adversarial verification scored them 7/10 — below the formal >=8 reporting bar but concrete failures of the shipped control's own stated threat model, so they were fixed rather than reported.
The documented sub-second DNS-rebinding residual race in connect-time revalidation is unchanged and remains accepted; network-level egress controls stay the preferred hardening.
reason: The connect_url split shipped in 0aa294f strips only query string, fragment, and userinfo from the plaintext display url, but the catalog's Zapier personal-link flow embeds the whole secret in the URL path, so for that first-class flow the live credential still sits in plaintext in mcp_connections.url, in scrubbed error messages, and in repr output; and the 0029 backfill never touched last_error, so rows whose probe failed before the deploy can retain a full token-bearing httpx URL in the plaintext last_error column. Display URLs now keep only scheme and host (which also aligns the OAuth moved-host reset with its stated host-binding semantic), and migration 0030 re-strips stored display URLs and clears stale last_error.
rollback: git revert of the single commit restores path-preserving stripping and the head-expectation baseline; migration 0030 has an empty downgrade because nothing it changed needs restoring (display URLs stay valid origins, cleared last_error values were stale pre-scrubber diagnostics). Dev DB rows re-strip on the next create/update per row if reverted.
security_impact: Completes the MCP URL credential split shipped in 0aa294f against its own threat model. strip_url_credentials previously kept the URL path, but the catalog's Zapier personal-link flow embeds the entire secret in the path, so the live credential still reached the plaintext url column, scrubbed last_error text, repr output, and logs; display URLs are now reduced to origin (scheme+host+port) everywhere. The 0029 backfill also never touched last_error, so probes that failed before the error scrubber existed could retain full token-bearing httpx URLs at rest; migration 0030 re-strips every stored display URL from the decrypted connect_url and clears stale last_error. Origin-only comparison also aligns the OAuth moved-host token reset with its stated host-binding semantic. No new attack surface: connect_url handling, approval gating, and SSRF revalidation are untouched.
summary: Finish MCP URL credential-stripping: drop path tokens from display URLs and scrub stale last_error
